why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Download the BTQ Core release Download the Windows or Linux archive from the BTQ Core releases page , compare its checksum with the published one, and unpack it. macOS has no binary, so you compile from source there.

2 Step 2 : Configure and start your node In ~/.btq/btq.conf add a [test] block with rpcport=18332, port=19333 and a long random rpcpassword of your own, as the mining guide shows. Then run ./btqd -daemon -testnet and confirm it has synced with ./btq-cli -testnet getblockchaininfo .

3 Step 3 : Create a Dilithium wallet Run ./btq-cli -testnet createwallet "dilithium_wallet" , then call getnewdilithiumaddress on that wallet and keep the address field of the result. Back up the wallet file with backupwallet, as the wallet basics page describes.

4 Step 4 : Connect to the pool and mine For the public testnet pool , run ccminer with -a sha256d against the pool's stratum address and pass your Dilithium address as the username with -u. To mine solo instead, mine against your own synced node.
